mapper.sql: a.account_id AS accountId, i.name AS bankName, a.account_name AS accountName, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.account_display_number, ''), a.account_number) AS displayNumber, CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.account_subtype, ''))) IN ('CHECKING', 'CURRENT', 'DEPOSIT', '입출금', '입출금통장', '보통예금', '요구불예금') THEN '입출금' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.account_subtype, ''))) IN ('예금', '정기예금', 'TIME_DEPOSIT', 'TERM_DEPOSIT') THEN '예금' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.account_subtype, ''))) IN ('SAVINGS', '적금', '정기적금', '청약') THEN '적금' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.account_subtype, ''))) = 'CMA' THEN 'CMA' END AS accountType, COALESCE(a.balance, 0) AS balance, COALESCE(a.currency, 'KRW') AS currency, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FINANCIAL_GOAL_ACCOUNTS selected_account INNER JOIN FINANCIAL_GOALS selected_goal ON selected_goal.goal_id = selected_account.goal_id WHERE selected_goal.user_id = #{userId} AND selected_account.account_id = a.account_id ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS selected
